# TheirStack

TheirStack provides job posting, company, and technographic data for sales intelligence, market research, and recruiting workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/theirstack/.

## Actions

- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected team's API/UI credit allowances, cumulative usage, and earliest expiration so an agent can budget credit-consuming…
- **Get Credit Consumption** (read-only): Return daily API and UI credit consumption for an optional time range and timezone to monitor usage trends.
- **List Company Lists** (read-only): List company lists available to the connected team, including IDs and company counts, without modifying list membership.
- **List Datasets** (read-only): List TheirStack dataset families and whether the connected team is entitled to each one.
- **List Saved Searches** (read-only): List saved searches available to the connected team without creating, updating, archiving, or unsubscribing anything.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Search companies by durable identifiers and firmographic, industry, funding, or technology filters.
- **Search Industries** (read-only): Find industry names and IDs for company and job filters.
- **Search Jobs** (read-only): Search current and historical jobs using a required posting-date or company filter, optionally refined by title, location, seniority,…
- **Search Keywords** (read-only): Find TheirStack technology and other semantic keyword slugs.
- **Search Locations** (read-only): Resolve place names or country and feature filters to TheirStack location IDs for precise job searches.
